Volume 52 is the 52nd volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga and the first volume in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.

In VIZ Media's translation, this volume is published as volume one of a separately numbered series, "Pokémon Adventures: Black 2 & White 2".
plainText:
Volume 52 is the 52nd volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga and the first volume in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.

In VIZ Media's translation, this volume is published as volume one of a separately numbered series, "Pokémon Adventures: Black 2 & White 2".

==Blurb==
Colress, the new leader of Team Plasma, is attacking the Unova region. His machines control Pokémon, wielding their powers for evil instead of good. Fortunately, a way to jam the signals is stored on a memory card. But who has the card…? A girl at the Pokémon Trainers’ School! Maybe that’s why our hero is such a flirt—he’s just doing his job gathering intel. But he’d better stop playing the field and find that card fast before someone beats him to it!

==Important events==

transfers into the Trainers' School.

Whitley is revealed to be a former member of Team Plasma.
Blake is revealed to be a member of the International Police.
Drayden calls Cheren to inform him about .
appears and is revealed to be Team Plasma's secret weapon developed at the P2 Laboratory.
Colress is revealed to be behind 's development and to be Team Plasma's new leader.
Genesect is revealed to be controlled by a machine instead of being a caught Pokémon. Blake successfully captures the Pokémon.
It is revealed that there was schism within Team Plasma and important research data was entrusted to a .
Blake tries to get closer to Whitley and takes her to Pledge Grove where they are attacked by .
Cheren takes the class on a trip to Pokéstar Studios, and Whitley and Blake participate in a movie.
Brycen is revealed to have quit his job as a Gym Leader and suggests that Cheren become Aspertia City's Gym Leader.
is revealed to have had a part in Pokéstar Studios's creation.
Hugh finds Whitley's pendant, which contains a microchip inside.
Hugh discovers data containing information on Pokémon liberated by Team Plasma on the microchip, vowing to find her.
Hugh flashes back to five years ago, where the he gave to his sister for her birthday was stolen by Team Plasma.
